## Questionnaire codebook (2023)

Translated from the original Korean codebook. "Answer values" lists each coded value and its meaning (taken from the 2023 questionnaire answer sheet), or the data type for numeric and free-text items. For multiple-response items, each option is its own variable and holds that option's number when selected. Heading levels can be adjusted to fit your document.
